name: Squallblood
body:
The magic of the winds flows strongly in your magic.

Prerequisite: Cha 13, able to cast a spell with the [air] descriptor.

Benefit: When you use a spell with the [air] descriptor to make a combat maneuver or grant a bonus to CMD, you gain a +4 bonus to the CMB or CMD, as appropriate.
